# Jira import

## What it does
Reads selected Jira issues read-only and stores their stable IDs with exported records. [1]

## When to use
When selected project work items should appear in the local notebook.

## Review boundary
Confirm the intended project and treat a rate limit as incomplete work, not an empty result.
